training_source: ChEMBL CHEMBL1942 exact Ki, human binding assays with confidence 9, literature source and no annotated variant
label: pKi = 9 - log10(Ki in nM)
external_aggregation: unweighted mean of five validation-fold models
architecture: existing full SGF-DTA affinity network; frozen Uni-Mol2 and ESM-2 features; freshly trained affinity head and interaction branch
selection_basis: Selected before generating any ADRA2B model predictions for a large systematic human direct-binding panel with more deposited actives than the preceding ADORA2A case and available public Ki references.
scope: Third exploratory non-kinase case after ESR1 and ADORA2A; both preceding cases are retained. Retrospective parent-disjoint evaluation.
external_endpoint: AC50 from direct ADRA2B binding in the Secondary Pharmacology Database; concentration threshold 10 micromolar
candidate_policy: Exclude missing/invalid structures, unsupported encoder size and all repeated standardized parent groups, without using activity to choose representatives. Assign Active for exact AC50 <= 10000 nM, Inactive for exact AC50 > 10000 nM or a strict lower bound >= 10000 nM; exclude threshold-ambiguous bounds.
target_mapping: Original author Zenodo 7378746 SI_tables_release.xlsx Table S2 identifies preferred assay 3159 as human ADRA2B binding; ChEMBL external assay CHEMBL5291737.
